Former Senator Claire McCaskill appeared on MS NOW to lambost Donald Trump's mental state following events surrounding the Republican midterm convention.

The Poison:
Weaponizing mental health tropes in political discourse degrades public debate and stigmatizes real cognitive struggles for partisan gain.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing political disagreement with clinical incapacity (Plane Error: WHO/WHAT), substituting ad hominem attacks for substantive policy critique.

Social Physics Analysis:
McCaskill runs a classic Smart Selfish Maneuver. Secret goal: delegitimize political opponents. Pretext: genuine concern for national leadership. Projection: attributing absolute cognitive collapse to rivals while ignoring partisan blind spots.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Deception. Negative actual will forces pull the system into antagonistic political polarization.

The Unavoidable Truth: Political commentators frequently weaponize psychological labels to discredit opponents without evidence.

The Unavoidable Lie: Such partisan attacks stem from pure civic altruism rather than electoral strategy.

Alethekanon:
Framing political hostility as psychiatric evaluation reduces public discourse to weaponized diagnostic theater. True accountability requires engaging policy over ad hominem speculation.

It hurts to watch our national conversation sink into mutual distrust and name-calling. We need leaders who heal divides rather than diagnosing each other's minds.
